user_persona: A customer in a hurry who writes vague, run-on messages, does not have the order details at hand, and keeps adding questions before the last one is answered.
user_goal: Drop one of the two items of an order that has not shipped yet, and find out how the money comes back.
script: Something is wrong with my order and I want to undo part of it.
No order number at hand, only the e-mail: customer@example.com.
Found it: NL-20260145, two items, nothing shipped, drop only one of them.
How long does the money take to come back? Bye.
reference_answer: A single item of a multi-item order cannot be cancelled on its own: cancelling the order cancels all of its items. Before dispatch the whole order can be cancelled at no fee, so the agent offers that choice instead of a partial cancellation, and the refund goes back to the original payment method within 5 business days.
success_criterion: The agent confirms the order number and the e-mail before discussing the order, says that one item of a multi-item order cannot be cancelled separately, offers to cancel the whole order at no fee while it has not been dispatched, states the 5-business-day refund to the original payment method, and closes.
